body.name: \(T_{D,y}\)
body.construction: For each \(D\in\mathfrak D\), expand \(\sum_{v_{V\setminus(X\cup Y)}}\prod_{j\notin X}p(v_j\mid v_{\operatorname{pa}_D(j)})\) at \(X=x\) and \(Y=y\), express each conditional probability as an observed-table marginal ratio, and reduce to \(T_{D,y}=A_{D,y}/B_{D,y}\) while recording every uncancelled denominator.
